name: Sao
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at a radius estimated from brightness with an assumed albedo of 0.04; not measured axes.
credit: Sheppard, Jewitt and Kleyna (2006), The Astronomical Journal 132, 171; Table 3, radius for an assumed geometric albedo of 0.04
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the 22 km radius Sheppard, Jewitt and Kleyna (2006) estimate for S/2002 N2 from its brightness, assuming a geometric albedo of 0.04. The size is not measured.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no pole or rotation state is adopted.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed colour or terrain.
introduction: Sao is a distant, irregular moon of Neptune, found in 2002 as S/2002 N2. Its size is estimated from its brightness.
card: A distant, irregular moon of Neptune.
datasetSummary: A sphere at 22 km radius, estimated from brightness with an assumed 4% albedo.
